extends.description: A preset from branchpolicy_presets of the server config; a rule of the file with the name of a preset rule replaces it.

mode.description: warn turns every denial into a warning; the default is enforce.

rules.description: Classes of branch names; a new branch takes the first rule whose match it fits, a name that fits none is denied.

deny.description: true: branches of this class may not be created.

examples.description: Names that pattern must accept and reject; checked when the file is accepted, not shown to users.

match.description: Pattern of the class as in GitLab protected branches: * matches any characters, including /.

message.description: Text shown when a branch is denied, up to 1000 characters: the format with an example and, for protected, what to protect.

pattern.description: RE2 regular expression that the whole branch name must match.

protected.description: true: a new branch of this class must be a protected branch of the GitLab project.

user_prefix.description: true: the part of the name before the first / is the username of an active GitLab user.
